title: Native (non-SNARK) rating schemes for FoodChain: measured gas of two prototypes
howMeasured: Every 'osaka' / 'prague' number is the gasUsed of the receipt of a transaction mined on the in-process Hardhat network. The breakdown is taken from debug_traceTransaction (cost of a step = gas before it minus gas before the next step of the same frame) and is checked, for every transaction, to add up exactly to gasUsed. 'glamsterdamEstimate' values are NOT measured: they re-price the operations of the Osaka trace with the gas schedule that is live on Sepolia since 2026-10-06.

hardforks.note: Hardhat 2.28.6 already defaults to osaka, so 'default hardfork' and 'osaka' are the same thing here; prague is reported as the pre-Fusaka reference. The CLZ opcode (EIP-7939, new in Osaka) works on the default/osaka network and is an invalid opcode on the prague network.

eip2565.formula: max(200, floor(words^2 * iteration_count / 3)), words = ceil(max(base_len, mod_len) / 8), iteration_count = bit_length(e) - 1 for an exponent of at most 32 bytes

eip7883.formula: max(500, multiplication_complexity * iteration_count), multiplication_complexity = 2 * words^2 when max(base_len, mod_len) > 32 bytes (16 otherwise); no division by 3

sepoliaCrossCheck.summary: Sepolia no longer runs Osaka. Since 2026-10-06 13:53:36 UTC it runs Glamsterdam (eth_config activationTime 1791294816, the timestamp EIP-7773 lists for Sepolia; the latest header has blockAccessListHash and slotNumber). Precompile prices are the Osaka ones (modexp per EIP-7883), but the intrinsic base, the calldata floor and state/storage prices changed.

rsa.scheme: RSA-2048 Chaum blind signature, full-domain hash, e = 65537; token = address of a one-time secp256k1 key
rsa.fdh: FDH(token) = (B_0 || ... || B_7) mod N, B_i = keccak256(FDH_TAG (32 bytes) || token (20 bytes) || uint8(i)), big-endian, FDH_TAG = keccak256('DeliveryChain/RSA-FDH/v1'). Counter-mode keccak256 expansion and reduction mod N; NOT the PSS encoding of RFC 9474. The reduction is a second modexp call with exponent 1.
rsa.encodings: 2048-bit values as bytes32[8] (static, no ABI offset/length words); tokenSig as EIP-2098 compact (r, yParityAndS); exponent passed to the precompile as a 32-byte word
rsa.digestSignedByOneTimeKey: keccak256(abi.encode(keccak256('DeliveryChain/RSA-rate/v1'), chainid, contract, worker, score)), signed raw
rsa.firstVsLater: issue: 'first' = the worker's issued counter goes 0 -> n (new slot), 'later' = it was already non-zero. rate: 'first' = totalScore and totalRatings go 0 -> non-zero (two new slots), 'later' = both already non-zero. Every rating also writes one new slot (the spent token).

lsag.scheme: LSAG-style linkable ring signature on alt_bn128 G1; key image I = x*H with H fixed per worker (try-and-increment hash-to-curve of the worker address, stored once)
lsag.verification: per ring member: L = s*G + c*P, R = s*H + c*I, c' = keccak256(prefix || L || R) mod Q (4 ECMUL + 2 ECADD); accepted iff the chain closes on c_0
lsag.prefix: keccak256(abi.encode(keccak256('DeliveryChain/LSAG-rate/v1'), chainid, contract, worker, score, keccak256(ring points), I.x, I.y))
lsag.firstVsLater: rate: 'first' = totalScore and totalRatings go 0 -> non-zero, 'later' = both already non-zero. Every rating also writes one new slot (the key image).

bls.note: the hash-to-curve loop makes the gas depend on the token: each extra try costs one more field square root (modexp 4016 under Osaka, 1338 under Prague) plus loop overhead

comparison.note: osaka = measured (the schedule of the baseline figures and, per EIP-7773, of mainnet today); glamsterdamEstimate = estimate for Sepolia as it is since 2026-10-06. The baseline is not re-priced.

roughBaselineUnderGlamsterdam.basis: derived by reading contracts/Reputation.sol and applying the same price changes; the baseline was not re-measured or traced
roughBaselineUnderGlamsterdam.submitRating: writes one new slot (nullifier, SLOAD then SSTORE: +88,020), changes two counters (+7,200 each), makes one cold call to the verifier (+400), base -6,000: about +96,800, i.e. roughly 381,000 to 388,000
roughBaselineUnderGlamsterdam.addRatingTicket: writes one new slot (known root: +87,920), changes root and nextIndex (+7,100 and +7,200) and one filledSubtrees slot per zero bit of the leaf index (+7,100 each; 8 on average over a full depth-16 tree, 12 or more for a worker with fewer than 16 tickets), completedOrders on every second ticket (+7,200), one cold call to the hasher (+400): roughly +160,000 to +210,000 per insertion
